questions.question: What is CLAUDE.md and how does Claude Code use it?
questions.answer_summary: CLAUDE.md is a markdown file giving Claude Code persistent, project/user/org-scoped instructions, loaded at the start of every session, with directory-hierarchy resolution and support for @path imports up to 4 hops deep.

questions.question: Is .cursorrules deprecated?
questions.answer_summary: Yes — Cursor deprecated the single .cursorrules file around version 0.43 in late 2024 in favor of Project Rules in .cursor/rules/, though the legacy file is still read for backward compatibility.

questions.question: What's the difference between .cursorrules and the newer .cursor/rules/*.mdc files?
questions.answer_summary: The legacy .cursorrules file applies globally with no scoping; .mdc files in .cursor/rules/ support YAML frontmatter, glob-based path scoping, and multiple activation modes.

questions.question: How does GitHub Copilot's copilot-instructions.md differ from CLAUDE.md?
questions.answer_summary: Copilot's file is a single flat repo-wide markdown file (plus optional path-scoped .instructions.md files), while CLAUDE.md has a fuller multi-scope model (managed/user/project/local), directory-hierarchy loading, and an automatic 'auto memory' system Copilot doesn't have.

questions.question: Does Claude Code automatically read AGENTS.md?
questions.answer_summary: No — Claude Code only reads CLAUDE.md by default; to reuse an existing AGENTS.md, you import it into CLAUDE.md with '@AGENTS.md' or symlink CLAUDE.md to it.

questions.question: Can CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, and copilot-instructions.md coexist in the same repository without conflict?
questions.answer_summary: Yes — since each tool only looks for its own filename/location, all three can live in the same repo without interfering with each other.

questions.question: Does Claude Code's /init command pull in existing Cursor or Copilot rule files?
questions.answer_summary: Yes — /init reads .cursor/rules/, .cursorrules, and .github/copilot-instructions.md and incorporates relevant parts into the CLAUDE.md it generates.

questions.question: Why does Claude, Cursor, or Copilot sometimes seem to ignore my rules file?
questions.answer_summary: These files are context, not enforced configuration, so vague or conflicting instructions, files that never actually loaded (wrong location), or context dilution over a long session can all cause inconsistent adherence; Claude Code's own docs recommend hooks instead of CLAUDE.md for anything that must run every time.

questions.question: What's the recommended maximum size for a CLAUDE.md file?
questions.answer_summary: Anthropic recommends keeping each CLAUDE.md file under 200 lines, since longer files consume more context and reduce instruction adherence.

questions.question: Does Cursor apply rules differently in Agent mode vs Edit mode?
questions.answer_summary: Reported behavior is that Cursor's Agent mode finds, loads, and follows rules properly, while the older 'edit' mode doesn't automatically pick up rules unless manually added to context.

questions.question: What priority order does GitHub Copilot use for personal, repository, and organization instructions?
questions.answer_summary: Personal instructions take the highest priority, followed by repository instructions, with organization instructions applied last.

questions.question: Can rules be scoped to only certain files or folders in both Claude Code and Cursor?
questions.answer_summary: Yes — Claude Code's .claude/rules/ supports YAML 'paths' glob frontmatter to load a rule only for matching files, and Cursor's .mdc files support similar glob-scoped activation.

questions.question: What happens to CLAUDE.md content after a long session gets compacted?
questions.answer_summary: The project-root CLAUDE.md is re-read from disk and re-injected automatically after /compact, but nested subdirectory CLAUDE.md files and path-scoped rules are not automatically re-injected until Claude reads a matching file again.

questions.question: Is there a universal instructions file that works across Claude, Cursor, and Copilot?
questions.answer_summary: AGENTS.md is emerging as a cross-tool convention that multiple agents are adopting; Claude Code specifically supports importing an existing AGENTS.md into CLAUDE.md rather than requiring duplication.
